name: neubat-tooling
description: Tooling de desarrollo del repo NEUBAT (hooks de git, lint-staged, commitlint). No es parte del producto.

*.sh: sh -c 'if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck -x "$@"; else echo "shellcheck no instalado; omitido"; fi' --
lint-staged.portal/frontend/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}: sh -c 'if [ -d portal/frontend/node_modules ]; then cd portal/frontend && npx oxlint >/dev/null; else echo "oxlint omitido (sin node_modules del frontend)"; fi' --
lint-staged.{configs,portal/catalog,portal/e2e}/**/*: sh -c 'for f do python3 -m json.tool "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done' --
